Amit has been absolutely amazing!
When we brought Darby home at 13 weeks old, he wasn’t toilet trained or crate trained, and we were really struggling to establish a routine. We felt completely overwhelmed and, at times, even regretted getting a puppy. We felt awful for having those thoughts when everyone who met Darby adored him and told us how lucky we were to have him.
We reached out to Amit for help, and his first visit, when Darby was 17 weeks old, made such a huge difference. From the moment he arrived at our home, Amit immediately put us at ease. He showed us some simple training techniques to get Darby’s attention and focus, helped us identify that his food needed changing to a healthier, more balanced diet, and gave us clear, practical guidance to help us move forward.
At the time, our floors were covered in puppy pads, but Amit gave us the confidence and instructions to remove them and take Darby outside regularly, staying with him until he went to the toilet. Within just one week, Darby was fully toilet trained! We honestly couldn’t believe the progress, and we never looked back.
We also completed the group training sessions, where we learnt how to maintain Darby’s attention and focus in the real world, with all the distractions of people, other dogs and noise. The training gave us the knowledge, confidence and tools to help Darby become the happy, well-rounded dog we always hoped he would be.
Darby is now one year old, and when I think back to January, when we first met Amit, I never imagined we would be in such a wonderful place today. We now confidently walk Darby off lead every day, and he absolutely loves playing and interacting with every person and dog he meets.
Amit didn’t just train our puppy, he helped us understand him, gave us confidence as first-time dog owners, and completely changed our experience of having a puppy.
We would absolutely recommend Amit and his team to anyone looking for expert, caring and practical puppy training. We will always be so grateful for everything they have done for us and Darby! 🐾

Yes it's costly- but worth every penny .

We bought a Lab x Lurcher when he was two months old. We call him Dover. Spent two months training him by using online resources and advice from friends, but by the end of four months, we gave up. There was a desperate need for a professional dog trainer to help with eating, sleeping, behaviours, and other issues. After a few online searches, we found Amit and his Woofology dog training service. We signed up for a one-on-one puppy training and a six-week puppy class, for a total of 4 months. The positive‑reinforcement methods have made a huge impact on our dog’s development. They take the time to explain the “why” behind each technique, and everything is based on kindness, patience, and understanding canine behaviour. Our 8‑month‑old Lab–Lurcher mix responds beautifully to their approach. We’ve seen improvements in recall, loose‑lead walking, impulse control, and overall confidence. In addition, Amit talked through the impact of a dog's diet on a dog. We changed our dog's diet and continue to source high-quality dog food and snacks for our puppy. If you’re based in the West Midlands and looking for a trainer who truly understands dogs and prioritises welfare, you can get in touch with Amit. Now, we are part of the Woofology family and are looking forward to the next dog social gathering, which the four-legged and their owners all enjoy very much.

If you are thinking of training your dog with love, kindness and results, reach out to woofology. When walking our puppy cockerpoo, we came accross a border collie who was 6 months old and so calm, obedient and tolerant of our reactive pup (who was petrified of other dogs). The owner told us her dog was trained by Amit at woofology, so we decided to look up woofology and make an enquiry. We had lots of information back, reassuring us that everything we described about our pup's behaviour was completely normal. We weren't sure what to expect, but when we met Amit, we relaxed immediately. Our puppy absolutely loves him and was a model student. The training helped us reinforce some basic commands we'd tried ourselves, but also helped us bond with our puppy, the whole family got involved and received feedback from Amit who helped us perfect the techniques. Amit really listens and cares about the difficulties we have faced and helps find something that works for us. As well as one to one work in the house, we've been on walks with Amit's dog Elio which has helped our puppy stop being absolutely petrified of other dogs. She no longer trembles with fear when another dog comes near.
We did a group puppy class to take our puppy's learning journey to the next level, responding in more 'real life' situations with strangers and several dogs.

We cannot recommend Woofology enough. When we adopted our dog almost two years ago as a rescue from Romania, she had burns on her face, scars on the backs of her legs, and was terrified of anything that moved. She reacted to both humans and dogs no matter how much distance there was, and everyday life felt overwhelming for her — and for us.

After 12 months of working with Woofology, the transformation has been incredible. She is now accepting of humans outside the house (even if she’s not quite ready for affection yet), and she has made her first dog friend — someone she can safely play with off lead and without a muzzle, purely for fun. Seeing her experience that kind of freedom and joy has been emotional for us.

Woofology has guided us with so much patience, understanding, and compassion, always moving at our dog’s pace and helping us truly understand her needs. We are now starting to move into more open environments to safely meet other dogs, something we never thought would be possible at the beginning of this journey.

I’ve included photos from the day she left the centre to now, and they truly show just how far she’s come.

Thank you, Woofology, for helping our dog feel safer in the world and for giving us hope when we needed it most.

Working with Amit at Woofology has been life changing for me and my collie x lab Joey. Amit's a great listener and really took the time to understand Joey as an individual - he never made me feel rushed when I was explaining Joey's complex traits and behaviours that had built up over time (food guarding/resource guarding/on lead and off lead reactivity/lack of manners...there was alot). Over the 6-hour training package I went with, Joey came on so far.  My nervous, reactive boy has turned into a much calmer, confident young pooch and I’m so proud of him — but I know we couldn’t have got here without Amit 🙂 His knowledge of dog nutrition made a huge difference too; after making the changes he suggested, Joey’s coat is shinier, his digestion healthier, he's even emotionally more settled - the benefits have been endless. Was good not to have to fork out for a nutritionist separately which I was close to doing with how dodgy Joey's tummy could be.
Our last socialisation walk with Elio, Amit’s therapy dog was such a good time too - Elio is a lovely, gentle presence and helped Joey build confidence so fast.
I’m so grateful we found Amit - he's got a gift. Love his holistic approach, simply cant fault anything 🙂

Old Dog…..New Tricks!
Amit is exceptional-passionate, compassionate, empathetic and intuitive with  an extensive breadth and depth of knowledge and methods to help your dog and you.
After three and a half years we had long ago reached a plateau with Milo our terrier cross who was rescued at 6 years old from a private home, isolated and mostly caged, malnourished, badly matted and extremely reactive with no positive experiences of life and the outside world. After 10 visits to give him time to begin to get used to us we brought him home.
We thought we had done as much as we could to make Milo’s life as good as possible including the use of prescription fluoxetine but a chance meeting with Amit and Elio changed his and our lives.
Through improved nutrition and enrichment Amit laid a strong foundation to ensure Milo was in a better mental and physical condition to build his resilience to his triggers.
Over the last 6 months improvements have been achieved way beyond what we ever thought was possible for a dog with no positive experiences of life for the first 6 years and since his rescue an often unknown and overwhelming world of potential threats.
His reactivity is greatly reduced and continues to diminish and he is so much happier and more relaxed enabling him to cope with different experiences.
At 10 years plus Milo is living his best life ever and we are full of optimism for the future.
Thankyou so much Amit and Elio.

This was a few years ago, we’ve now have another little friend and we’re still using the techniques we were taught and it’s going amazingly!

Amit is a first class trainer with a passion for dogs to match! The dedication that he puts in to help us to help our dog is second to none.

We can’t thank Amit from Woofology enough for all their help and support with our dog! He’s always struggled with anxiety, especially at this time of year with all the fireworks and socialising with other dogs has been a real challenge for him. Over the course of this year we have worked with 3 other training providers, both in a group setting and on a 1-2-1 basis and I can say with complete confidence that Amit and his team have been head and shoulders above everyone we've worked with. We have a 10 month old cockapoo who was quite nervous around people and dogs and we were really struggling with her loose lead walking.
From the initially 2hr consultation, Amit spent time with our pup, assessing her behaviour and gathering an understanding about her and her needs. He did a deep dive in to nutrition, neutering, giving us insight in to certain behaviours and why our pup acts the way she does sometimes. We felt understood, and he really took the time to tailor our 1-2-1 sessions with a bespoke schedule created by himself. During these sessions we found out our pup has a really good nose for scenting games which has been an absolute game changer for her and an outlet for some of her energy. We had no idea until we were shown this. He also recommended natural supplements to help with her anxiety levels and wow what a difference we've seen in her over the past few weeks, she's settled and able to cope with situations so much better now.
As well as the 1-2-1 sessions we also joined his group puppy class to help our pup with some extra supervised socialisation and to help us really cement some of the training we'd already been doing. It's been another game changer for our pup as week on week you could really see the confidence building in her, allowing her to meet and get used to people and other dogs in a calm and controlled manner. She's really responded well to these training sessions and we've really enjoyed meeting the other owners and pups during class
Amit really cares about the wellbeing of your pup, he's professional, committed, knowledgeable and really takes the time to understand the problems you're facing. Without Amit's help we would not be in the position we are today with our pup, she's greeting new dogs by choice and no longer scared of new people, it's been everything we'd hoped for her and more. If you're looking for a truly professional trainer who will listen, care and tailor training to your pups needs, Amit is your man.

Woofology: A Game Changer for Me and My Pup 🐾

When I first reached out, my Labrador was an anxious little soul at just 12 weeks. A few barks from other dogs made walks unbearable—he’d pull, refuse to pee or poo anywhere but the garden, and even struggled to get into the car. It was heartbreaking.
Then Amit came over for an initial consultation—and everything changed. He doesn’t just train your dog, he trains you too! Within just one hour, my puppy was happily jumping into the car. Amit even brought his dog Elio into the mix, which worked wonders.
Walks are now a joy, and my puppy absolutely adores Amit. His knowledge of nutrition and supplements has also made a huge difference in our journey.
I’m still having sessions with Amit because let’s be honest, training is often more for the humans than the dogs! 😄
If you're looking for a more fulfilled life with your dog, don’t hesitate. Amit and Woofology are truly life changing. Forever grateful for your support and patience, Amit.

Thank you for all your help!!!

I would recommend him to anyone whether you are just starting out or like me you already have some skills of your own to draw on.

Really fun and engaging classes. Our puppy learnt a lot and has grown to be much more comfortable around other puppies. Lots of opportunity every class to practice what's been learnt - I highly recommend!

I have been working with Amit and Woofology Dog Training since August 2024 following a biting incident with a family dog.
From the first session it was clear that this isn't just a job for him, it's a passion. His depth of knowledge about dogs, their behaviour and their nutritional needs is second to none.
The holistic approach to understanding dogs and sharing that knowledge with me as an owner has been invaluable. Amit took the time to understand my dog's personality and energy, and help us understand where his behaviours and anxiety may be coming from.
The advice provided on nutrition was also game changing. He explained the importance of providing my dog with high quality kibble and wet food, as well as the benefits of CBD on my dogs mood and behaviour.
The results so far have been fantastic! My dog is noticeably calmer, happier and settled. He's also more engaged during walks, and there's been a significant improvement in our overall bond.
Beyond his expertise Amit has a calm demeanor and an amazing ability to connect with dogs. My dog who can be anxious around new people, took to him very quickly. It's clear that he genuinely cares about the wellbeing of every dog he works with.
I'm so grateful for his guidance and support. He has helped me become a better dog owner who is so much more attuned to my dog and his needs, and I cannot thank him enough for this.
If you're looking for a dog trainer who is knowledgeable, caring, truly understands the needs of dogs, and is passionate about his career, I wholeheartedly recommend Amit and all of the team at Woofology Dog Training (including Elio of course), and I look forward to continuing our work together with my dog in the future!
